purpose: Measure the execution-cost boundary of the unchanged frozen candidate; descriptive robustness research, not rescue or optimization.
boundaryDefinition: Highest tested extra cost per side with P/L > 0 and PF >= 1.00. No interpolation is used for the gate.

gate.PASS: Boundary >= 0.20% extra cost per side and DD >= -10% at every tested point through that boundary.
gate.HOLD: Boundary >= 0.10% but < 0.20% extra cost per side, with no tested DD < -15%.
gate.FAIL: Boundary < 0.10% extra cost per side, or any tested DD < -15%.

researchRules: No use as independent OOS evidence
G2/G3 Real Forward remains higher evidence
